name: PjatiFan
source:
Roma Pyatifan has reached his breaking point. Escaping a brutal conflict at home, he flees into the freezing darkness of the village with nothing but a butterfly knife and a backpack. But the streets are far from safe: a curfew is in effect, and terrifying rumors of a maniac haunt the shadows. Now, he is utterly alone and must decide where to run when there is nowhere left to go.

Will you seek the help of Lieutenant Tikhonov, the only adult who seems to care, or will you risk your life dealing with shady strangers and hiding in abandoned buildings?
translation:
罗马·皮亚提凡 (Roma Pyatifan) 已经达到了极限。为了逃避家里的残酷冲突，他只带着一把蝴蝶刀和一个背包，逃进了寒冷黑暗的村庄。但街道远非安全：宵禁已经生效，有关疯子的可怕谣言萦绕在阴影中。现在，他孤身一人，必须决定在无处可去的情况下该逃往何处。

你会寻求吉洪诺夫中尉的帮助吗？他是唯一一个关心此事的成年人，还是你会冒着生命危险与可疑的陌生人打交道并躲在废弃的建筑物中？
